dct:provenance: Generated from the authoritative HGNC download root, Statistics & download files page, HGNC homepage, About the HGNC page, HGNC License Agreement, and the HGNC-recommended PubMed citation record. The configured depth was 2. The configured blacklist excluded archive, custom-download, gene-group-table, CGI download, help, data/API, and other listed branches. The JavaScript statistics page was evaluated for its default all-chromosome view; chromosome-filtered derivative files were not separately enumerated because they are overlapping subsets rather than distinct source holdings. The public bucket contains unlinked duplicate .tsv aliases and chromosome-filtered derivatives; only assets rendered or explicitly described by the in-scope authoritative pages were included. TSV/TXT fields were derived from exact in-band header tokens. Datatype inference inspected at most five physical lines per tabular file (header plus up to four rows). JSON fields were derived from exact property names in at most the first five records of $.response.docs[*]; properties absent from those sampled records may consequently be undocumented. Nested JSON values were conservatively typed as Text. JSON property names containing punctuation, such as pseudogene.org, use bracket-quoted JSONPath selectors without changing the property name. The compressed lsdb_links.txt.gz file is a single compressed tabular file, not an archive. The OWL ontology has no tabular RecordSet. No archive files were discovered in the permitted crawl scope. No coherent country/state/city or latitude/longitude columns were observed, so no additive GeoCoordinates field is supported.
